name: openalgo-script
description: An open trading language. Write a study or a strategy once, plot it, backtest it, trade it.

scripts.check:no-eval: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-no-eval.mjs
scripts.test: node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-duplication.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-error-codes.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-examples.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-layering.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-limits.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-modularity.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-names.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-raises.mjs && npm run build && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-defaults.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-chart-surface.mjs && npm run test:unit && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/check-no-eval.mjs && npm run bench
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run generate && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/clean-output.mjs tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:test: npm run generate && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings scripts/clean-output.mjs tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.generate: npm run generate:errors && npm run generate:version
